verdict.rationale: The pack shows a public GitHub repository (github.com/gnachman/iTerm2) documenting the product's features, and a community report says a fix was 'committed upstream'. Together these show the source is publicly readable. However, no item names the license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license (e.g. GPL/LICENSE file), first-party docs pointing to the source, independent corroboration of licensing terms.
